svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Modern SaaS web stack
svg.desc: Modern SaaS web stack. 12 components in 5 groups. Connections: Web to Cloudflare; Mobile app to Cloudflare; Cloudflare to API service (api.example.com); Cloudflare to Next.js app (app.example.com); API service to Neon (SQL); API service to Upstash; API service to Stripe (checkout); API service to Stripe (webhooks); API service to Resend; Next.js app to Clerk (sign in); API service to Sentry; Next.js app to Sentry; Next.js app to PostHog.

text.tspan: Cloudflare fronts a Next.js app on Vercel and an API service; Neon and Upstash hold the data while Clerk, Stripe and Resend handle auth, payments and email
